verdict.rationale: Reflect publishes a REST API with OAuth2/PKCE and bearer-token curl access (OpenAPI spec on openpm), plus Zapier connectivity. Scripts and automation can append to daily notes, create notes and manage links without the app UI. However, end-to-end encryption means the API cannot read note contents, and the surface is limited to appends, links and a few other operations. missing for 10: an official CLI or documented headless/CI mode, non-interactive service-account or token guidance for CI, read access to note contents, a sandbox/test environment, a versioning policy, and independent or hands-on corroboration of automation use.
